apiKeys.title: API & BI Integration
apiKeys.description: Create API keys so Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Google Sheets and custom scripts can pull your CRM data automatically.
apiKeys.createDesc: Name the key so you can recognise it later, pick a scope and an optional expiry.
apiKeys.yourKeysDesc: Keys that can access this organization's data via the REST API.
apiKeys.yourKeysDescAdmin: All keys in this organization — as an admin you can revoke any of them.
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to connect your BI tools.
apiKeys.keyShownOnce: Copy this key now — for security it will never be shown again.
apiKeys.revokeDesc: This will permanently revoke "{name}". Any tool using this key will immediately lose access. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.docsIntro: Point any REST client or BI connector at the base URL below and authenticate with your API key.
apiKeys.paginationDesc: list endpoints accept page and limit (max 100) query parameters and return a pagination block with total counts.
apiKeys.incrementalDesc: pass modified_since=ISO datetime to fetch only records updated after that moment — ideal for scheduled refreshes.
apiKeys.biGuideBody: Power BI: Get Data → Web connector, paste the base URL and add the X-API-Key header under Advanced options. Tableau: use a Web Data Connector pointing at the contacts endpoint. Metabase and Google Sheets: any REST/JSON connector works — authenticate with the key, then set a refresh schedule so the data is pulled automatically.
